Class Row

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.board.Row
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Row extends Object implements Serializable
A single row of the board (top or bottom). Holds the three kinds of cards separately: characters, buildings and events (the latter in a priority queue so they are resolved in the correct order).
